title: Props: Passing Data to Components
description: Send data from parent to child with props, including types, validation, and defaults.

slides.title: What Are Props?
slides.content:
# Props: Parent → Child Communication **Props** (short for properties) are custom attributes you can register on a component to pass data from a parent to a child. ```html ``` Inside the child, you declare the prop and use it like data: ```javascript const ChildComponent = { props: ['message'], template: `
{{ message }}
` } ``` Props are **one‑way**: the parent updates them, and the child receives them but should not modify them directly.

slides.title: Prop Validation
slides.content:
You can specify prop types and validation rules to catch bugs early:

```javascript
props: {
  title: String,                     // simple type
  likes: Number,
  isPublished: Boolean,
  commentIds: Array,
  author: Object,
  callback: Function,
  contactsPromise: Promise,
  // with validation
  age: {
    type: Number,
    required: true,
    default: 18,
    validator: (value) => value >= 0
  }
}
```

Vue will warn you in the console if the passed value doesn't match the expected type.
